_comment: S4 verification inputs for the rf4 golden (test fixture). The RF feed chain (RF1 pi-match segment + RF_FEED 50-ohm feed) references the solid In1 GND plane; the plane-split mutant slots In1 under /RF_FEED.

placement._comment: S9 placement inputs. J1 is an edge-mount SMA clamping the right board edge (most of its courtyard hangs off by design).

rf_match.note: TEST antenna: the impedance rf4's golden pi matches

esd._comment: check_esd (#312): J2 is the SPI header to the host board (board-to-board), so it is not judged. /RF_FEED (the SMA) has no clamp; the pi-match's 8.2 pF and 5.6 pF shunts do not stop a strike, so the finding is real. It is exempt here because the golden is a never-built fixture whose verify run must stay clean, and tests/test_check_esd.py pins it as a true finding.
